annotations.title: Day-by-day plan of a trip option

description: The day-by-day plan of one option of a trip planned with plan_trip: for each day the times, places and prices, and what to arrange before leaving. Use it when the traveller wants to see what each day looks like. Give the trip id, and optionId only for an option other than the recommended one. Read only: it changes nothing. Times marked typical are usual times, not from a timetable.

optionId.description: The option id from plan_trip or get_trip; the recommended option when not given.

tripId.description: The trip id that plan_trip returned.
